title: Konkrete issue #31: Enchantment Table crashes game

text:
[issue by Spiderman31807]
I didn't have this crash (i dont use this mod), but i looked at a crash report of somebody else on my server since im a modder, and from what i could tell the cause was your mod using a mixin that tried to access a field that was private in the class. Not sure why it does that when you could just @shadow the field but either way, should be a simple fix for you- heres the crash report they sent me!

[message (1).txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28417492/message.1.txt)

[comment by Keksuccino (owner)]
- The user is using MC 1.21.8, which I do not support anymore.
- The log itself does not really point to it being caused by Konkrete, and I also don't really remember accessing that field in Konkrete tbh (could be wrong tho).
- When I work with an AW/AT instead of `@Shadow`, it normally is for a good reason. I prefer shadow.
